name: @aifsd/sdk
description: SDK for AI-first software delivery and application integration

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run check:types && bun run build:types && bun run build:runtime
scripts.build:runtime: bun build src/config/index.ts --outdir dist/esm/config --target=node --format=esm --external '@geekist/llm-core/*' --external '@geekist/strict-json' --external '@wpkernel/pipeline/*' && bun build src/integrations/index.ts --outdir dist/esm/integrations --target=node --format=esm --external '@geekist/llm-core/*' --external '@geekist/strict-json' --external '@wpkernel/pipeline/*'
scripts.validate: bun run check:types && bun run lint && bun run test
